maml:description.maml:para: Downloads a PHP version and registers it with IIS.

The Install-PHPVersion cmdlet downloads a PHP for Windows build from downloads.php.net, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, checks that the download is complete, extracts it, checks that the extracted PHP is the requested build to the specified folder and registers it with IIS in the same way as New-PHPVersion. The new version becomes active only when Activate is specified. The folder must be empty or not exist; its permissions are set so that only administrators can change the PHP files. Archived releases are published without a checksum and are refused unless AllowUnverified is specified.
A branch (for example 8.4, installs its latest release) or an exact version (for example 8.4.26).
Folder where PHP is extracted. The default is %ProgramFiles%\PHP\<version>-<ts|nts>-<architecture>.

maml:description.maml:para: Updates the active PHP version to the latest release of its branch.

The Update-PHPVersion cmdlet installs the latest patch release of the branch of the active PHP version (same thread safety, compiler and architecture) side by side in a new folder, copies the php.ini settings and the extension DLLs that are not part of the official build, and makes the new version active. The previous version stays registered, so Set-PHPVersion can switch back to it.

maml:description.maml:para: Copies php.ini settings and extensions from another PHP version to the active one.

The Copy-PHPIniSettings cmdlet compares the php.ini of a registered PHP version with the php.ini of the active PHP version and copies the settings that differ and the extensions that are enabled. Paths that point to the folder of the source version are changed to the folder of the active version. When the DLL of an enabled extension does not exist in the active version, the cmdlet looks for a PECL build compatible with the active version and installs it; if there is none, the extension is returned but not copied. Directives that the active version does not know are also returned but not copied. Use -WhatIf to only list the changes.
Handler name of the PHP version to copy from, as returned by Get-PHPVersion.
